stories.headline: ADCC 2026 Roster Takes Twin Hits as Mica Galvao and Giancarlo Bodoni Both Withdraw
stories.summary: Mica Galvao has withdrawn from ADCC 2026 in Krakow following the arrest of Melqui Galvao, while Giancarlo Bodoni is also out after undergoing two surgeries earlier this year — the most significant dual roster setback to hit the September event since invitations went out.

stories.headline: Gracie Barra Wins Team Title at IBJJF American Nationals; Grand Slam Contenders Clay, Hopstock, Jaworski Take Gold Again
stories.summary: Gracie Barra claimed the overall team title at the IBJJF American Nationals (June 25–27, Las Vegas), while Grand Slam frontrunners Elisabeth Clay, Tarik Hopstock, and Pawel Jaworski all won gold again to stay on course for the No-Gi Grand Slam crown.

stories.headline: Polaris Announces First-Ever Mainland Europe Events: Open Spain in Barcelona and Open Netherlands in Utrecht
stories.summary: Polaris is expanding beyond the UK for the first time, debuting Polaris Open Spain in Barcelona on August 29 followed by Polaris Open Netherlands in Utrecht on October 24 — opening the promotion's open-tournament circuit to continental European competitors and fans.

stories.headline: Jacob Rodriguez to End 17-Month Hiatus at Pit Submission Series July 24
stories.summary: Former ADCC silver medalist Jacob Rodriguez is returning to professional grappling competition on July 24 at the Pit Submission Series, ending an absence of more than 17 months since his last match.

stories.headline: Mbappé Brace Destroys Sweden 3-0 at MetLife, Sets All-Time World Cup Knockout Goals Record
stories.summary: Kylian Mbappé scored in the 45th and 74th minutes and Bradley Barcola added a third as France cruised past Sweden 3-0 at MetLife Stadium on June 30; Mbappé's 6-goal tournament total sets the all-time World Cup knockout stage scoring record and France advance to face Paraguay in the Round of 16.

stories.headline: Haaland's 86th-Minute Goal Gives Norway Historic First-Ever World Cup Knockout Win Over Ivory Coast
stories.summary: Erling Haaland netted in the 86th minute to give Norway a dramatic 2-1 win over Ivory Coast in the Round of 32 on June 30 — Norway's first-ever victory in a World Cup knockout match — sending them through to the Round of 16.

stories.headline: Atlético Files FIFA Complaint Against Barcelona and Also Rejects Real Madrid's €150M Álvarez Bid
stories.summary: Atlético CEO Miguel Ángel Gil Marín formally lodged a FIFA and RFEF complaint accusing Barcelona of illegally approaching Julián Álvarez; separately, Atlético also rejected a €150M bid from Real Madrid for the striker, publicly mocking both clubs, even as Barcelona prepares a revised offer of up to €135–150M.

stories.headline: Lee Kang-in Agrees Personal Terms With Atlético Madrid on Deal Through 2031
stories.summary: Lee Kang-in has agreed personal terms with Atlético Madrid on a contract through 2031 for a fee of approximately €35M, with his PSG exit now confirmed; if completed, he would become the first Asian player ever to represent Atlético.

stories.headline: U.S. Futures Dip at Q3's Open as Wall Street Digests Blockbuster 9.6% First-Half S&P Gain
stories.summary: Index futures opened Q3 in the red on July 1 — S&P 500 futures off ~0.3% — as investors paused after the S&P's 9.6% H1 gain and Nasdaq's 12.8% surge; key ADP June jobs data and ISM Manufacturing PMI were due to set the tone for VTI and U.S. equity ETFs entering the holiday-shortened week.

stories.headline: Apple Confirms July 30 Earnings Date; Wall Street Models $1.89 EPS and 14–17% Revenue Growth
stories.summary: Apple set its fiscal Q3 2026 earnings call for July 30 after the close, with the Street expecting $1.89 EPS and ~$110.8B in revenue following last quarter's $111.2B (+17% YoY); Wedbush holds a $400 price target and 28 of 47 analysts rate the stock a Buy at an average target near $315.

stories.headline: Spotify Audiobooks+ Hits $100M ARR Milestone Just Ahead of July 29 Earnings
stories.summary: Spotify's Audiobooks+ add-on is reaching $100M in annualized recurring revenue in July 2026 — up from near-zero two years ago with 1 million subscribers — as the market awaits Q2 2026 earnings on July 29, when analysts will scrutinize whether higher AI compute spending is resolving into margin expansion.

stories.headline: NJ Stay NJ Senior Property Tax Credit Sends Second Quarterly Checks This Month; Mortgage Rates Near 6.27%
stories.summary: New Jersey's Stay NJ program — which rebates 50% of property taxes (up to $6,500) for eligible homeowners 65+ — begins its second quarterly installment this month alongside Senior Freeze payments starting July 15; NJ 30-year purchase mortgage rates are sitting near 6.27% APR as Q3 opens.

stories.headline: Count Basie Orchestra Opens Montclair Jazz Festival Soundcheck Series Tonight at Lackawanna Station
stories.summary: The Legendary Count Basie Orchestra under guest conductor John Faddis kicks off the 2026 Montclair Jazz Festival Soundcheck Series tonight at Lackawanna Station — with the Alvin Ailey Dance Company joining in honor of America's 250th — building to the August 15 Downtown Jamboree with Dianne Reeves and Christian McBride.

stories.headline: Brookdale Park Free 'Music Through the Decades' Concert and Fireworks Happening Tonight
stories.summary: Essex County's free summer concert featuring Van Martin, The Discoteks, and The Empire begins at 7 p.m. tonight at Brookdale Park's Watchung Avenue meadow, with a fireworks spectacular to follow — no tickets needed, bring a blanket.

stories.headline: Montclair State University Officially Takes Over NJ PBS Today
stories.summary: As of July 1, Montclair State University's College of Communication and Media assumes management of New Jersey's four public TV stations, returning control to a NJ institution for the first time since 2011 and launching a nightly NJ-centric newscast and at least 6 hours of local programming per week.

stories.headline: Montclair's July 4th Parade, Picnic, and Fireworks at Yogi Berra Stadium This Saturday
stories.summary: This Saturday's annual Montclair Independence Day celebration features an 11 a.m. parade down Bloomfield Avenue and Valley Road to Edgemont Park, a family picnic, and an evening fireworks show at Yogi Berra Stadium on the Montclair State campus — all free and a short drive from anywhere in town.

stories.headline: Clay, Hopstock, and Jaworski All Win Gold at No-Gi Brasileiros, Keeping Grand Slam Bids Alive
stories.summary: The CBJJ No-Gi Brasileiros (June 27–28), streaming live on FloGrappling for the first time, saw defending world champions Elisabeth Clay, Tarik Hopstock, and Pawel Jaworski all win gold to stay on track for the 2025–26 No-Gi Grand Slam, with Clay and Jaworski also claiming the open-class titles.

stories.headline: ADCC Amateur World Championship to Debut Alongside Main Event in Krakow This September
stories.summary: For the first time, the ADCC Amateur World Championship will run concurrently with the main ADCC Worlds at Tauron Arena in Krakow, Poland on September 12–13, giving up-and-coming competitors a chance to perform on the same stage as the sport's elite.

stories.headline: Grappling Calendar Turns to IBJJF American Nationals and Polaris 33 After No-Gi Brasileiros
stories.summary: With No-Gi Brasileiros wrapped up and the Polaris 33 bracket now released, the summer grappling schedule shifts to the IBJJF American Nationals as athletes build final ADCC Worlds preparation ahead of the Krakow event in September.

stories.headline: Barcelona's €100M Álvarez Bid Rejected; Clubs Meet as Atlético Privately Concedes Exit Is Near
stories.summary: Atlético turned down Barcelona's initial €100M bid for Julián Álvarez and are holding firm at €150M, but direct club-to-club meetings are now confirmed; Atlético privately concede the departure is near-inevitable after Simeone reportedly lost patience following the player's public transfer request.

stories.headline: World Cup R32: Germany Out on Penalties to Paraguay, Morocco Shocks Netherlands — France Faces Sweden Tonight at MetLife
stories.summary: Paraguay pulled off a massive Round of 32 upset, beating Germany 4–3 on penalties after a 1–1 draw, while Morocco similarly shocked the Netherlands 3–2 in a shootout; France plays Sweden tonight (June 30) at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford at 5pm ET.

stories.headline: Goretzka Officially a Free Agent Today; Atlético Mulls Bid but Wage Demands Likely a Dealbreaker
stories.summary: Leon Goretzka's Bayern Munich contract expired June 30, making him a free agent with Atlético Madrid among interested clubs; however, his ~€15M/year salary demands are beyond what Atlético can accommodate, with Sporting's Morten Hjulmand remaining the club's top midfield target.

stories.headline: S&P 500 Closes Q2 at 7,436, Up ~9% YTD as VTI Posts 8.6% First-Half Gain
stories.summary: The S&P 500 ended Q2 2026 at approximately 7,436 — up about 9% year-to-date and only 3% off all-time highs despite a rough June; VTI gained roughly 8.6% in H1 with a 12-month total return near 32%, rewarding long-term index investors who held through the tech selloff.

stories.headline: AAPL Closes Q2 at $282 as Analysts Project Record iPhone and Mac Market Share in H2 2026
stories.summary: Apple ended the quarter near $282 with a Buy consensus (avg. target $315); Counterpoint Research forecasts iPhone's global market share rising to 25% and Mac to 12% by year-end, suggesting demand remains resilient despite recent device price hikes driven by memory shortages.

stories.headline: SPOT Down 43% YTD Entering Q3, but 778M MAU Guidance and July 29 Earnings Could Flip Sentiment
stories.summary: Spotify shares remain deeply in the red for 2026, but Q2 guidance targets 778M monthly active users and €4.8B in revenue (+15% y/y) with gross margin near 33.1%; with 34+ analysts maintaining buy ratings and earnings due July 29 before market open, the report is the next major inflection point.

stories.headline: Free Concert and Fireworks at Brookdale Park Tomorrow, July 1 — All Ages Welcome
stories.summary: Essex County's free Summer Concert Series kicks off July 1 at 7pm at Brookdale Park (Watchung Ave, Bloomfield) with "Music Through the Decades" — Van Martin, The Discoteks, and The Empire — followed by a fireworks spectacular; bring a blanket and enjoy the show at no cost.

stories.headline: Free Outdoor Screening of 'Love, Simon' in Montclair This Wednesday, July 1
stories.summary: A free outdoor showing of "Love, Simon" (2018, PG-13) is scheduled for July 1 at 50 South Fullerton Ave in Montclair — a family-friendly pre-holiday film night ideal for tweens and teens.

stories.headline: World Cup Knockout Week at MetLife: France Tonight, Spain July 2, Argentina July 3
stories.summary: Families near Montclair can catch back-to-back World Cup knockout matches at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford: France vs. Sweden tonight (June 30, 5pm ET), Spain vs. Austria on July 2, and Argentina vs. Cape Verde on July 3 — all within a 30-minute drive.

stories.headline: Owen Jones Docked 30% of Purse After Missing Weight Before Andrey Upset
stories.summary: At the ONE Fight Night 44 weigh-ins, Owen Jones came in over the featherweight grappling limit, forcing a catchweight bout and a 30% purse forfeiture before he went on to beat Fabricio Andrey by split decision.

stories.headline: UFC's Valter Walker Says He's Abandoning Heel Hooks for Striking
stories.summary: UFC heavyweight and feared leg-lock specialist Valter Walker says he has dropped jiu-jitsu and wrestling from his training entirely ahead of his July 25 Abu Dhabi bout, opting to trade strikes instead, with one exception if he ever fights Josh Barnett.

stories.headline: Team North America Edges Europe 5-4 in Polaris' First-Ever Women's Squads Event
stories.summary: Polaris 32 made history June 28 with the promotion's first all-female Squads showdown at Swansea Arena, with Brianna Ste-Marie's back-to-back wins sealing a narrow 5-4 win for North America after Nia Blackman stepped in as a late-replacement captain for Ffion Davies.

stories.headline: Lee Kang-in's Move to Atlético Madrid Enters Final Stage as PSG Lines Up Replacement
stories.summary: Atlético and PSG are closing in on a deal for Lee Kang-in worth roughly €30-35M, with PSG now arranging personal terms with Monaco's Maghnes Akliouche as his direct replacement, a clear sign the transfer fee is largely settled.

stories.headline: Atlético Madrid Enters Race for Udinese Defender Oumar Solet, Threatening to Gazump Inter Milan
stories.summary: Atlético are preparing a roughly €25M bid for Udinese centre-back Oumar Solet, jumping ahead of Inter Milan, whose lower offer has stalled while the Serie A club waits on outgoing sales to fund the move.

stories.headline: Alphabet Officially Joins the Dow, Ending Verizon's 22-Year Run
stories.summary: Alphabet (GOOGL) replaced Verizon in the Dow Jones Industrial Average effective June 29, joining Nvidia, Amazon, Apple and Microsoft and pushing the price-weighted index's tilt further toward AI and cloud computing.

stories.headline: Oil Prices Climb as US-Iran Strikes Cloud Hopes for Reopened Hormuz Shipping
stories.summary: Brent crude rose about 0.9% Monday after weekend US-Iran strikes renewed doubts about a return to normal shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, even as both sides agreed to resume ceasefire talks in Doha.

stories.headline: NJ Homeowners Insurance Premiums Climbed 7.5% Last Year, Outpacing Pennsylvania
stories.summary: New Jersey home insurance rates rose 7.5% over the past year versus just 1% in Pennsylvania, driven by more frequent severe weather and rising labor and materials costs, though NJ's average premium ($1,449) still trails the $2,395 national average.

stories.headline: World Cup Fever Hits Montclair as National Teams Check Into MC Hotel
stories.summary: The MC Hotel on Bloomfield Avenue has become an unofficial World Cup basecamp, with Germany's team spotted there and England fans waiting over an hour for their team's bus to arrive as squads use Montclair as a stopover for matches at MetLife Stadium.

stories.headline: Vegan Bakery Yellow Rose Opens Second Location in Montclair's Lackawanna Plaza
stories.summary: Yellow Rose Vegan Bakery & Cafe, the all-vegan, kosher bakery known for its original Maplewood shop, has opened a new outpost inside Lackawanna Plaza at 1 Lackawanna Plaza in Montclair.

stories.headline: Formula Race Cars Return to NJ Motorsports Park for SpeedTour Weekend
stories.summary: The New Jersey Lottery SpeedTour with SVRA brings F4 U.S. and FR Americas open-wheel racing back to NJ Motorsports Park in Millville July 31-August 2, part of a packed 2026 season that also includes monster trucks.

stories.headline: Montclair Pride Festival Postponed a Second Time, Now Set for October 11
stories.summary: Out Montclair pushed the 2026 Pride Festival back again, from its planned August 1 date to October 11, citing rising production costs and a sharp drop in corporate sponsorship after losing its presenting sponsor.

stories.headline: Helena Crevar Books Return Bout vs. Paige Ivette Clymer at ONE: The Inner Circle
stories.summary: ONE Championship announced that 19-year-old grappling star Helena Crevar will face ADCC West Coast Trials winner Paige Ivette Clymer in a 10-minute openweight submission grappling match at The Inner Circle on July 17 in Bangkok.

stories.headline: ADCC 2026 Superfight Set: Kaynan Duarte vs. Yuri Simoes for Vacant Title
stories.summary: With Gordon Ryan's retirement leaving the ADCC superfight belt vacant for the first time in 17 years, Kaynan Duarte will challenge Yuri Simoes for the title at September's World Championship in Krakow, Poland.

stories.headline: 14-Year-Old Joslyn Molina Set to Become Youngest-Ever ADCC Competitor
stories.summary: Joslyn Molina has accepted her invite to the -65kg division at ADCC 2026, making her the youngest athlete ever to compete at the prestigious championship after organizers lowered the age-eligibility threshold.

stories.headline: Julián Álvarez Publicly Confirms He Wants to Leave Atlético Madrid
stories.summary: Álvarez told ESPN he has informed Atlético's hierarchy of his desire for a transfer, with Barcelona his preferred destination; Atleti's CEO is refusing to sell and has threatened a FIFA complaint against Barcelona over an alleged improper approach.

stories.headline: Atlético Madrid Closing In on Lee Kang-in, but Juventus Threatens to Hijack Deal
stories.summary: Atlético and PSG midfielder Lee Kang-in have reportedly agreed personal terms, but Juventus has emerged as a late complication as the clubs negotiate a transfer fee nearing €35 million.

stories.headline: World Cup 2026 Knockout Stage Begins: South Africa vs. Canada Opens Round of 32
stories.summary: The FIFA World Cup's Round of 32 kicks off today with South Africa facing Canada at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles, the first of a full week of knockout-stage matches across the tournament.

stories.headline: Apple Lobbies Washington to Buy Memory Chips From Blacklisted Chinese Supplier CXMT
stories.summary: Apple is seeking U.S. government clearance to source DRAM from sanctioned chipmaker CXMT as a severe AI-driven memory shortage drives up component costs, though the move risks the same bipartisan backlash that sank a similar 2022 effort.

stories.headline: Billionaire Hedge Funds Pile Into Amazon as a Cheaper AI Bet
stories.summary: Bill Ackman's Pershing Square, David Tepper's Appaloosa, and Seth Klarman's Baupost have all built major Amazon stakes, betting AMZN is undervalued relative to other AI plays even as AWS grew 28% last quarter to $37.6 billion.

stories.headline: SALT Deduction Cap Quadruples to $40,000, Boosting NJ Homeowners
stories.summary: The federal SALT deduction cap has risen from $10,000 to $40,000 for 2025-2029 under the new tax law, delivering meaningful relief to high-property-tax New Jersey homeowners who itemize, with the benefit phasing out above $500,000 income.

stories.headline: VTI Raises Quarterly Dividend for a Fifth Straight Year
stories.summary: Vanguard's Total Stock Market ETF (VTI) declared a quarterly dividend of $1.0437 per share on June 25, payable June 30, marking its fifth consecutive annual increase.

stories.headline: SZA, Donald Payne Sr., Dr. John McMullen Lead Essex County's 2026 NJ Hall of Fame Class
stories.summary: The New Jersey Hall of Fame's Class of 2026 includes Maplewood's SZA, Newark's Donald Payne Sr., and Montclair High grad Dr. John J. McMullen; the 18th annual induction ceremony, hosted by Danny DeVito, takes place September 24 at American Dream.

stories.headline: Where to Catch July 4th Fireworks Near Montclair This Year
stories.summary: Families looking for fireworks near Montclair can head to Bloomfield's Foley Field (gates 5:30pm), Cedar Grove's Panther Park (July 2, dusk), or Livingston's Memorial Oval (July 4, 9:15pm) for free Independence Day celebrations.

stories.headline: Montclair Film's Free Outdoor Movie Series Screens 'Best in Show' July 26
stories.summary: Montclair Film's 'Movie Night Under the Stars' continues with a free screening of the dog-themed comedy 'Best in Show' at Anderson Park on Sunday, July 26 (rain date August 2), kicked off by a pre-show dog parade.

stories.headline: Montclair Foundation Offers Free Virtual Meditation Sessions This Summer
stories.summary: The Montclair Foundation's summer Virtual Meditation series, led by teacher Ramananda John E. Welshons, continues with Zoom sessions on July 1, 8, 22, and 29 from 7-9pm, open to beginners and experienced practitioners alike.

stories.headline: King Charles III Visits Roger Gracie Academy, Receives BJJ White Belt
stories.summary: King Charles III toured Roger Gracie Academy's London headquarters and was awarded a white belt by Roger Gracie himself, in a visit spotlighting Reorg, a military and emergency-responder charity that uses jiu-jitsu in veterans' recovery; the King also presented a black belt to a Reorg trustee who credits the sport with helping him through cancer treatment.

stories.headline: Craig Jones Admits He Used PEDs, Says He Was '100% Cheating'
stories.summary: Just days after announcing B-Team's revival, Craig Jones gave a blunt interview admitting to long-term steroid use — including injecting before EBI in Tijuana — and said he considers it cheating but stays open about it because 'the next generation is gonna take it anyway.'

stories.headline: Owen Jones Upsets Fabricio Andrey via Split Decision at ONE Fight Night 44
stories.summary: Britain's Owen Jones avenged a three-year-old loss to Fabricio 'Hokage' Andrey, edging him on the scorecards after a tense leg-lock battle to win the night's lone grappling bout and snap Andrey's three-fight win streak in ONE Championship.

stories.headline: ADCC 2026 Invite List Pulled From Website Amid Transparency Backlash
stories.summary: With ADCC Worlds set for September in Krakow, organizers quietly removed their official invite and qualification list from the website without explanation, leaving fans to piece together the lineup from athlete announcements and fueling debate over contested invites like Josh Saunders' return.

stories.headline: Álex Baena's Strike Sends Spain Top of Group, Knocks Out Uruguay
stories.summary: Atlético midfielder Álex Baena scored the only goal in the 42nd minute as Spain beat Uruguay 1-0 in Guadalajara, topping Group H and eliminating Uruguay from the World Cup while Cape Verde also advanced to the Round of 32.

stories.headline: Atlético Set to Sign Stuttgart Midfielder Enzo Millot by Triggering €23M Release Clause
stories.summary: Atlético have agreed personal terms with Stuttgart's Enzo Millot and plan to trigger his €23 million release clause, with Simeone targeting the playmaker — who scored 12 goals last season — as the club's eighth summer signing.

stories.headline: Dembélé Hat Trick Powers France Past Norway 4-1 as Sørloth Watches From the Bench
stories.summary: Ousmane Dembélé scored three first-half goals as France routed Norway 4-1 at the World Cup; Norway rested Atlético's Alexander Sørloth and Erling Haaland but still advanced to the Round of 32 as Group I runner-up.

stories.headline: Nasdaq Logs Fifth Straight Losing Session as Tech Selloff Caps Worst Week in Months
stories.summary: The Nasdaq fell for a fifth consecutive session Friday — down roughly 5% on the week — as Sandisk and Micron led chip-stock losses on AI-spending jitters and a report that OpenAI may delay its IPO, even as SpaceX shares rose ahead of a fast-tracked Russell 1000 addition.

stories.headline: Apple Rebounds 3% as Vision Pro Hardware Chief Departs for OpenAI
stories.summary: AAPL closed up 3.14% at $283.78 Friday, clawing back part of Thursday's price-hike-driven selloff, even as the company's Vision Pro hardware chief left for OpenAI; Morgan Stanley kept a Buy rating and $360 price target.

stories.headline: Spotify Could Be Nearly 31% Overvalued Heading Into Earnings and Reserved Launch
stories.summary: A Simply Wall St fair-value analysis pegs SPOT as roughly 30.8% overvalued ahead of its July 28 earnings and the launch of 'Reserved,' a Live Nation/Ticketmaster-built Premium ticketing feature, even though the stock still trades below peer-average earnings multiples.

stories.headline: PSE&G Shifts NJ Homeowners to Time-of-Use Electric Rates Starting June 1
stories.summary: PSE&G has automatically enrolled residential customers in a new Time-of-Use plan charging about $0.31/kWh during weekday 4-9pm peak hours versus roughly $0.09/kWh off-peak, with a 12-month savings guarantee for households that shift laundry and EV charging to nights and weekends.

stories.headline: Montclair's 4th of July Parade & Fireworks Returns to Yogi Berra Stadium
stories.summary: Montclair's annual Independence Day celebration kicks off with an 11am parade down Bloomfield Avenue and Valley Road to Edgemont Park, followed by a family picnic and an evening fireworks show at Yogi Berra Stadium on the Montclair State campus.

stories.headline: New Eats Land on Bloomfield & Church: Toastique, Hummus Republic Open, Ani Ramen Adds Sushi
stories.summary: Montclair's dining scene keeps expanding with Toastique opening a gourmet-toast cafe on Church Street, Hummus Republic taking over a former convenience store on Bloomfield Avenue, and Ani Ramen launching a new sushi program at its Bloomfield Ave location.

stories.headline: Vintage Racer Group Headlines New July Weekend at NJ Motorsports Park
stories.summary: New Jersey Motorsports Park's 2026 schedule adds a Vintage Racer Group weekend of classic cars on track July 10-12 in Millville, ahead of the New Jersey Lottery SpeedTour with SVRA bringing F4 and Formula Americas racing July 31-August 2.

stories.headline: Ben Eddy Survives Illegal Slam DQ in ADCC Dallas-Fort Worth Open Absolute
stories.summary: Ben Eddy, who took bronze at -70kg with four submission wins, was slammed by blue belt Jakori Savage during overtime of the absolute division at the ADCC Dallas-Fort Worth Open, drawing a disqualification; Eddy said he escaped without serious injury.

stories.headline: Islam Makhachev Reveals He's Turning Down Grappling and Wrestling Super-Fight Offers
stories.summary: UFC lightweight champion Islam Makhachev says he has received offers to compete in standalone grappling and wrestling super-fights but is declining them, citing camp demands and injury risk outside his MMA schedule.

stories.headline: Former WWE Star Tom Pestock Wins Gold at Jiu-Jitsu World League Event
stories.summary: Tom Pestock, known to wrestling fans as Baron Corbin, added another medal to his growing competitive BJJ resume with a gold-medal finish at a Jiu-Jitsu World League tournament.

stories.headline: Atlético Madrid Officially Completes Grimaldo Signing From Leverkusen
stories.summary: Atlético confirmed Alejandro Grimaldo as a new player on a deal through 2029 (plus an optional fourth year) for a fixed €15M fee plus variables, with the left-back saying he's 'always liked Atlético' ahead of his move to the Metropolitano.

stories.headline: USMNT Stunned by Turkey in Stoppage Time but Still Tops World Cup Group
stories.summary: The United States lost 3-2 to Turkey at SoFi Stadium on a last-gasp Kaan Ayhan goal in a dead-rubber match, having already clinched first place in Group D and a Round of 32 date with Bosnia and Herzegovina.

stories.headline: Atlético's Sørloth and Norway Face Mbappé's France for Group I Top Spot
stories.summary: Fresh off a brace against Senegal, Atlético striker Alexander Sørloth lines up with Norway against France on June 26 in Foxborough with first place in Group I on the line ahead of the World Cup Round of 32.

stories.headline: Juventus Push to Seal Sørloth Exit From Atlético Amid Nico González Swap Talk
stories.summary: Juventus and Alexander Sørloth's camp have personal terms agreed on a contract through 2029, but Juventus and Atlético are still negotiating a fee (Atlético want around €35M, Juve nearer €30M), with a possible Nico González swap also on the table.

stories.headline: Tech Selloff Deepens on Report OpenAI May Delay IPO to 2027
stories.summary: Asian and U.S. tech stocks fell to a two-week low after a report said OpenAI may push its IPO into 2027, sending SoftBank shares down as much as 13% and reviving fears about AI-spending payoffs even as fresh data showed the U.S. economy growing faster than estimated.

stories.headline: Apple Shares Extend Slide as UBS Flags 19% Drop in China iPhone Sell-In
stories.summary: AAPL fell another ~6% to $275.42 after UBS data showed iPhone sell-in in China dropped 19% year-over-year in May, deepening worries that Apple's recent price hikes on Macs and iPads could trigger demand destruction; Wall Street's average target of $314 still implies upside.

stories.headline: Spotify Shares Tick Up on New Ticketing Feature Ahead of July 28 Earnings
stories.summary: SPOT rose about 2.7% in a recent session, even as the stock remains down roughly 19% year-to-date, as investors eye the rollout of 'Reserved,' a Premium ticketing feature built with Live Nation and Ticketmaster, with 34 of 41 covering analysts rating it buy/outperform.

stories.headline: Jersey City Pulls Proposed 20% Property Tax Hike From Vote After Backlash
stories.summary: Facing a $255 million budget deficit, Jersey City's mayor yanked a proposed 20% property tax increase from the June 24 council agenda after public outcry; a new vote is set for July 1, with the average $11,000 tax bill potentially rising nearly $2,000 if it proceeds.

stories.headline: Montclair Library Lands $36.6M State Grant for Major Overhaul
stories.summary: The Montclair Public Library was awarded $36.6 million in NJEDA tax credits for a four-year renovation of its Main and Bellevue Avenue branches, including a new youth-focused floor with a STEAM lab, podcasting studio, and sensory room.

stories.headline: Vintage Motorcycle Racing Roars Into NJ Motorsports Park This Weekend
stories.summary: The 14th annual AHRMA Vintage Motorcycle Festival runs June 26-28 at NJ Motorsports Park in Millville, featuring vintage road and sidecar racing on Thunderbolt Raceway plus a swap meet, go-karting, and family-friendly activities.

stories.headline: Montclair High School Sends Off Class of 2026
stories.summary: Montclair High School held its Class of 2026 graduation ceremony on June 25 at the school's outdoor amphitheater, with Principal Jeffrey Freeman telling graduates resilience matters as much as their diplomas.

stories.headline: Free 'Summer of Soccer' World Cup Watch Parties Continue at Lackawanna Station
stories.summary: Montclair's Lackawanna Station is hosting a 39-day 'Summer of Soccer' series through July 19, screening World Cup matches on big screens alongside youth clinics, food vendors, and tournament play for the whole family.

stories.headline: Craig Jones Announces Return of B-Team Jiu-Jitsu With New Academy
stories.summary: Nearly a year after his dramatic exit from the original B-Team, Craig Jones announced he is reviving the B-Team brand with a brand-new academy that will serve as the team's headquarters, though the location has not yet been revealed.

stories.headline: Kade Ruotolo Withdraws From ONE Championship Title Defense Due to Injury
stories.summary: Ruotolo pulled out of his scheduled ONE Lightweight Submission Grappling World Title defense against Fabricio Andrey after sustaining an injury in his recent MMA win; Andrey has instead been rebooked against newcomer Owen Jones at ONE Fight Night 44 in Bangkok.

stories.headline: Eight Athletes Qualify for ADCC 2026 Worlds at Asia & Oceania Trials in Gold Coast
stories.summary: Roberto Frias scored one of the trials' biggest upsets by beating favorite Lucas Kanard to win the -88kg title, while Kaya Rudolph, Bekzat Kapashov, and women's qualifiers Nadia Frankland and Matilda Reid also punched their tickets to ADCC Worlds in Krakow.

stories.headline: Bia Mesquita Extends Unbeaten UFC Run With Third Straight Submission Win
stories.summary: BJJ legend Beatriz "Bia" Mesquita stayed undefeated in the UFC, submitting Melissa Mullins with a first-round armbar at UFC Vegas 119 after surviving an early scare, and immediately called out Ailin Perez for a future matchup.

stories.headline: Atlético and Leverkusen Reach Full Club-to-Club Agreement on Grimaldo, Beyond Personal Terms
stories.summary: Atlético Madrid and Bayer Leverkusen have closed a club-to-club deal for left-back Alejandro Grimaldo in the €20-25M range, with the player signing through 2029 plus an option — multiple outlets now call it done pending his medical and official presentation once Spain's World Cup run ends.

stories.headline: Atlético to File Formal FIFA Complaint Against Barcelona Over Álvarez Tampering
stories.summary: Atlético CEO Miguel Ángel Gil Marín announced the club will lodge a complaint with FIFA accusing Barcelona of negotiating with Julián Álvarez — under contract until 2030 — during the protected period, escalating the saga from rhetoric into formal regulatory action.

stories.headline: Correction: Bernardo Silva Signed With Real Madrid, Not Atlético, on a Free Transfer
stories.summary: Real Madrid officially confirmed Bernardo Silva on a free transfer after his Manchester City exit, signing a two-year deal under Mourinho — closing the door on Atlético's reported pursuit and contradicting the prior report that they were leading the chase.

stories.headline: World Cup 2026: Group Stage Winding Down, Knockouts Begin Sunday
stories.summary: The 2026 World Cup has passed its midpoint with Argentina (Álvarez, Messi) already through after beating Austria 2-0, while Spain — with Grimaldo on the squad — face Uruguay Friday in their final group match ahead of the Round of 32 starting June 28.

stories.headline: Market Rally Extends Into Thursday on Micron Follow-Through; Dow Hits Intraday Record
stories.summary: The S&P 500 and Dow extended Wednesday's Micron-driven rally into Thursday, with the Dow touching a fresh intraday record of 52,655.66, while the Nasdaq's gains were capped at a more modest 0.24% as Apple's slide weighed on the index.

stories.headline: Apple Drops ~5-6% After Hiking Mac, iPad, and Vision Pro Prices to Offset Memory Shortage
stories.summary: Apple raised prices by up to $300 across Mac, iPad, Vision Pro, and HomePod (e.g., MacBook Air to $1,299) citing a DRAM/NAND shortage tied to AI data-center demand, sending shares down 5-6% intraday; UBS kept a Neutral rating with a $296 target and Apple hinted further hikes may follow this fall.

stories.headline: VTI Hits Fresh High as Vanguard Overtakes iShares as Largest ETF Provider
stories.summary: VTI traded around $364.64 Thursday, riding the broader Micron-fueled rally, while Vanguard has reportedly overtaken iShares to become the largest ETF provider overall — a notable shift for index investors who rely on funds like VTI.

stories.headline: New Japanese Restaurant Ju-Ichi Opens on Bloomfield Ave as Uncle Momo Closes After 15 Years
stories.summary: Ju-Ichi, a family-owned ramen and sushi spot with locations in PA and Morristown, has opened its fourth location at 512 Bloomfield Avenue, while longtime Lebanese/Mediterranean spot Uncle Momo is closing this month after 15 years due to an unsustainable rent increase.

stories.headline: New Italian Restaurant Clementina Opens in Upper Montclair
stories.summary: Clementina, a modern Italian restaurant from Chef Michele Rocchi, opened June 5 at 627 Valley Road in the former Saunders Hardware space, adding to Montclair's deep bench of Italian spots.

stories.headline: Montclair Jazz Festival Announces 2026 Lineup Headlined by Dianne Reeves and Christian McBride
stories.summary: The 17th annual Montclair Jazz Festival's all-day Downtown Jamboree + Block Party is set for Saturday, August 15 at Lackawanna Plaza, featuring Dianne Reeves, Christian McBride Big Band with Bilal, and a youth-focused second stage from JAZZ HOUSE KiDS.

stories.headline: Montclair State University to Take Over Operation of NJ PBS Starting July 1
stories.summary: Montclair State University was selected over a competing independent public-media proposal to manage New Jersey's four FCC-licensed public TV stations, taking over programming and operations on July 1.

stories.headline: Tainan Dalpra Wins Fourth IBJJF World Title With All-Submission Run in Under Six Minutes Total
stories.summary: At the 2026 IBJJF World Championship in Long Beach, AOJ's Tainan Dalpra captured his fourth middleweight world title by submitting all four opponents in just six minutes of total mat time — one of the most dominant Worlds performances in the sport's history. Dalpra and Gabi Pessanha were the only two athletes to complete the full IBJJF Grand Slam in 2026, and both are now eyeing ADCC 2026 in Poland this September where they could pursue a rare Super Grand Slam. Dalpra also became the first male athlete to earn two IBJJF Grand Slam titles in a single season.

stories.headline: Atlético Madrid on Verge of Signing Bayer Leverkusen's Grimaldo as Left-Back Replacement
stories.summary: Atlético Madrid are reportedly close to finalizing a deal for Spanish left-back Alejandro Grimaldo from Bayer Leverkusen, with Leverkusen executives in Madrid to accelerate talks and a deal potentially wrapping up on June 24. Grimaldo, 30, had been pushing for a return to La Liga this summer with his Leverkusen contract expiring in 2027, and Atlético turned to him after missing out on Chelsea's Marc Cucurella to Real Madrid. The move would give Simeone a proven Bundesliga attacking full-back as the club simultaneously manages the ongoing Julián Álvarez transfer saga.

stories.headline: Markets Attempt Rebound Wednesday After Two-Day Tech Rout; Micron Earnings Loom as Key AI Test
stories.summary: After the S&P 500 fell 1.44% and the Nasdaq dropped 2.21% on Tuesday — led by a collapse in chip stocks including Micron (-13%), AMD (-5.8%), and Qualcomm (-8%) — futures pointed higher Wednesday morning as traders look to bargain-hunt. All eyes are on Micron's after-bell earnings report, where analysts expect roughly $35 billion in sales, as a critical read on AI infrastructure demand. Adding to macro uncertainty, BofA and Deutsche Bank now both forecast the Fed will raise rates three times in 2026 under Chair Kevin Warsh, with hikes projected in September, October, and December.

stories.headline: NJ Mortgage Rates Hold in Mid-to-High 6% Range as Home Prices and Property Taxes Stay Elevated
stories.summary: New Jersey's 30-year fixed mortgage rate sits between approximately 6.69% and 6.88% as of late June 2026, slightly above the national average, with monthly payments on a median-priced NJ home (~$563,000 with 20% down) running close to $3,000 before taxes. NJ also holds the nation's highest effective property tax rate at 2.49%, translating to roughly $830/month in escrow on a $400K home. With BofA forecasting potential Fed rate hikes later this year, would-be refinancers and buyers should act with caution, though more than 52% of NJ homeowners are currently equity-rich.

stories.headline: Montclair Flea Returns This Weekend at Lackawanna Plaza — Family-Friendly Vendors, Food, and Vintage Finds
stories.summary: The Montclair Flea is back at 1 Lackawanna Plaza on Saturday June 27 (11am–5pm) and Sunday June 28 (11am–5pm), featuring curated vendors with art, vintage items, food, and drinks — described as a fun, rain-or-shine outing for the whole family. It's a great low-key option for a 12-year-old who enjoys browsing unique finds, grabbing a bite, or soaking up the outdoor scene in downtown Montclair. The event runs through the summer and holiday season as well.

stories.headline: Montclair Pride Festival Moved to August 1 — Free All-Day Event with Live Music, Drag, Food Trucks, and Family Zone
stories.summary: Out Montclair has officially rescheduled the 2026 Montclair Pride Festival from June 13 to Saturday, August 1, citing financial and operational requirements needed to safely produce the event and keep it free and accessible. The downtown Montclair festival will feature live music, drag performances, food trucks, a family zone, bar areas, and an evening street-dance party. Families with kids can enjoy the family zone, and the rescheduled date gives more time to plan a summer outing.

stories.headline: Diego 'Pato' Oliveira Retires from Gi Competition After Winning Record Fifth World Title
stories.summary: Diego 'Pato' Oliveira capped the 2026 IBJJF World Championship by leaving his black belt on the mat — the traditional signal of retirement — moments after winning his fifth world title at light-featherweight, surpassing the records of both Robson Moura and his coach Guilherme Mendes. The 27-year-old AOJ athlete dominated his bracket with three submission wins and a 9-0 finals victory over Khaled Mohammad. His departure leaves a massive hole at the weight class, though questions remain about whether he'll continue competing in no-gi and professional events. Tainan Dalpra (4th world title, all submissions) and Gabi Pessanha (12th world title, double gold) were the other marquee stories from the event.

stories.headline: Julián Álvarez Publicly States He Wants to Leave Atlético Madrid to 'Fulfil His Dream' — Barcelona Understood to Be Destination
stories.summary: In a significant escalation of the transfer saga, Atlético Madrid striker Julián Álvarez said after Argentina's 2-0 World Cup win over Austria on June 22 that he wants to leave the club to fulfill his dream — widely understood to be a move to Barcelona. Atlético have dug in and do not want to sell the 26-year-old, who finished the 2025/26 season with 20 goals and nine assists across all competitions. Arsenal are also reportedly interested, but Álvarez's preference is Barcelona, who have been pursuing him all summer despite previously strained relations with Atlético. This is a new development from the previously reported smear-campaign dispute: now the player himself has broken his silence publicly.

stories.headline: Tech Stocks Tumble Tuesday as Global Selloff Spreads — Nasdaq Down Over 800 Points
stories.summary: A broad technology selloff accelerated on June 23, with Nasdaq 100 futures falling nearly 3% and South Korea's Kospi plunging roughly 10%, led by memory-chip giants Samsung and SK Hynix. In the U.S., chip stocks including Micron, Intel, and Qualcomm led premarket losses, while Alphabet shares continued sliding after two high-profile AI researchers departed for rivals (OpenAI and Anthropic). Market concerns center on the rising cost of AI infrastructure, potential Fed rate hikes later in 2026, and an Iran nuclear situation that remains uncertain. Defensive names and VTI's broad market exposure may cushion some of the blow, but investors in growth-heavy ETFs should expect continued volatility this week.

stories.headline: Apple Facing Analyst Scrutiny as CEO Confirms iPhone Price Hikes to Offset Memory Costs
stories.summary: Apple (AAPL) shares are trading around $294–297, down roughly 6% from their 2026 high of $317.40, as CEO Tim Cook confirmed rising memory and storage chip costs are forcing product price increases across the lineup. KGI Securities downgraded the stock to Hold (price target $315), while Wedbush maintained Outperform with a $400 target, citing strong pricing power and supply-chain resilience. BofA argues Apple's AI strategy reset announced at WWDC is being 'underappreciated' by the market. Investors are also watching a reported Intel chip manufacturing partnership and a CEO succession expected in September 2026, both of which add near-term uncertainty.

stories.headline: Montclair Launches Car-Free Church Street Pilot — Monthly Pedestrian Weekends Through October
stories.summary: Montclair has kicked off a new pilot program closing Church Street to vehicles from 10 a.m. to 10 p.m. on select weekends through October, turning the restaurant- and shop-lined block into a pedestrian plaza. The first closure ran June 19–21; the next is July 17–19. Township officials plan to bring performances and activations to the space, and local advocates point to research showing pedestrian streets boost restaurant and retail sales. The car-free weekends are a great family outing option, with outdoor dining, shops, and the nearby Clairidge movie theater all accessible on foot.

stories.headline: Maplewoodstock Music + Arts Festival Returns July 11–12 with 22 Bands, Kid Zone, and Food Vendors
stories.summary: The beloved Maplewoodstock festival celebrates its 21st edition on July 11–12 at Maplewood's Memorial Park, featuring 22 live bands, over 60 art vendors, a beer garden, and a dedicated kid zone. Organizers expect more than 14,000 attendees at the free community event, which is run entirely by volunteers and benefits arts education in local schools. The two-day outdoor event is a short drive from Montclair and is family-friendly, making it an ideal summer outing for parents and kids alike.

stories.headline: Gabrieli Pessanha Sets Women's Record with 12th World Title at IBJJF Mundials; Teen Brown Belt Earns Instant Black Belt Promotion
stories.summary: The 2026 IBJJF World Championship (May 28–31, Long Beach) produced two other standout stories beyond Diego Pato's record fifth title. Gabrieli Pessanha swept both the super-heavyweight and absolute women's divisions to become the most decorated female competitor in IBJJF Worlds history with 12 world titles. Meanwhile, teen prodigy Hazel Butcher-Salazar went six-for-six with all submissions in the women's brown belt divisions, winning double gold at heavyweight and absolute — and was immediately promoted to black belt on the podium afterward.

stories.headline: Atlético Publicly Blasts Barcelona Over Julián Álvarez 'Smear Campaign' as Player Reportedly Eyes Camp Nou Move
stories.summary: Atlético Madrid escalated their war of words with Barcelona over Julián Álvarez, publicly declaring the Argentine striker is 'not for sale' and accusing Barça of a 'relentless smear campaign' after months of transfer speculation. Atlético officials stated there had been 'no offer, no meeting, and no negotiation,' while absolving Álvarez of personal blame and praising his professionalism. Despite this, reports from Mundo Deportivo and ESPN indicate Álvarez has told both Arsenal and PSG that his priority is a move to Barcelona, with Atlético holding firm that any deal would require meeting his €500m release clause.

stories.headline: Markets Open Cautiously Monday as US-Iran Peace Roadmap Takes Shape and Fed Hawkishness Looms
stories.summary: US stock futures edged slightly higher Monday as Iran confirmed 'encouraging progress' in peace talks in Switzerland, with negotiators agreeing on a roadmap to a final deal within 60 days. Oil prices fell — Brent crude dropped ~1.7% toward $79/barrel — as hopes grew that the Strait of Hormuz would normalize. However, markets remained restrained heading into a key week: the Fed left rates unchanged last week but signaled a more hawkish stance, with nearly half of FOMC members now expecting at least one rate hike before year-end, and the PCE inflation report is due later this week.

stories.headline: Spotify Shares Up Sharply After Landmark AI Music Deal with UMG and Bullish Long-Term Targets; Multiple Buy Ratings
stories.summary: Spotify (SPOT) surged roughly 13–15% in late May after announcing a major AI licensing deal with Universal Music Group and unveiling its first investor day since 2022, where it set a long-term ambition of 1 billion users and $100 billion in revenue. The deal allows Spotify Premium subscribers to create AI-generated covers and remixes of songs by participating UMG artists via a paid add-on, with a revenue-share model for artists. As of mid-June, SPOT carries a Buy consensus from 22+ analysts (Morgan Stanley and Bernstein among recent reiterations), with a Wall Street average price target around $609–$681; next earnings are due July 28.

stories.headline: Montclair Film's Free 'Movie Night Under the Stars' Is Underway for Summer 2026 — Cars, Best in Show, and More in Local Parks
stories.summary: Montclair Film's beloved annual outdoor cinema series kicked off June 14 and runs through August, with all screenings completely free to the public. The 2026 lineup opened with Disney/Pixar's Cars (celebrating its 20th anniversary) at Nishuane Park, and continues with Best in Show (dogs welcome!) and a third animal-themed film later in the season. Families are encouraged to bring blankets and lawn chairs; registration is not required but recommended at montclairfilm.org to receive weather alerts and schedule updates.

stories.headline: 39 Days of Free Soccer Watch Parties at Lackawanna Station and World Cup Fans Swarming NJ Delis
stories.summary: Montclair's Lackawanna Station is hosting 'Summer of Soccer' — 39 consecutive days of free World Cup watch parties and tournament play running through the summer, making it a great option for soccer-loving families. Separately, NJ officials are working on transportation fixes after World Cup travel to MetLife Stadium exposed transit strain, with NJ Transit's $98 match-day fare continuing to draw criticism. On a lighter note, World Cup tourists have become obsessed with New Jersey delis while visiting the region for the tournament.
